BRIGHTEST_FLAME.title: Quality Flame
DEBT.title: Debt
ENTHRALLED.title: Enthralled
ENTHRALLED.description: If this is in your hand, you must play it before other cards. Gain 10 Block. Eternal.
FOLLY.title: Folly
EZMB_ROOT.title: Rootblight I
EZMB_ROOT.description: Play: Exhaust. Permanently remove this from your deck. Growth: if not played or removed this combat, it becomes Rootblight II after combat.
EZMB_DEEP_ROOT.title: Rootblight II
EZMB_DEEP_ROOT.description: Play: Exhaust. Remove this from your deck and add Rootblight I after combat. Growth: if not played or removed, it becomes Rootblight III after combat.
EZMB_ROOTBLIGHT_III.title: Rootblight III
EZMB_ROOTBLIGHT_III.description: Play: Exhaust. Remove this from your deck and add Rootblight II after combat. Growth: if not played or removed, it adds Rootblight I once.
EZMB_ROOT_BUD.title: Blight Sprout
EZMB_ROOT_BUD.description: Play: Exhaust. Sprout 3/4: at that round's start, if unseen, put this on top of your draw pile. If seen and not played, add 1 Rootblight I after combat.
EZMB_MARGINAL_NOTE.title: Marginal Note
EZMB_MARGINAL_NOTE.description: Retain. When played, Exhaust and draw 1 card. If this stays in your hand at end of turn, Knowledge Demon gains 1 Strength.
